title: PPT Slide Spec
description: One slide semantic design with an optional role, without title, hierarchy, placement, or page number.

key_message.description: The main takeaway the audience should retain from this page, not its title or a list of layout instructions.

type.description: Representation of this element: text for prose, list for items, metric for a key figure, quote for a quotation, table for tabular values, chart for data, diagram for relationships, code for a code sample, or asset for visual media. comparison is a page role; choose chart, table or diagram for a comparison element.

intent.description: What this element should communicate: the relevant content, evidence or relationship and its purpose on the page. Describe the intended content in natural language without inventing missing facts.

items.description: One planned content element, pairing a representation type with its communication intent.

elements.description: Ordered content elements planned for this page. Supplying this list replaces it completely; [] clears it. Each element describes what to communicate and how to represent it, not HTML source.

layout.description: Natural-language suggestion for arranging this page's content and reading order, such as a chart on the left and explanation on the right; not a template identifier or CSS.

role.description: How this page serves the narrative, such as introducing the topic (cover), supporting a claim (evidence), comparing alternatives (comparison), or closing with a takeaway (conclusion). This is not a visual template. Omit when undetermined; do not default to content.
